summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The company may sell up to $50 million of common stock from time to time through the agent, with a commission up to 3.0% and customary indemnification. The ATM offering is registered under an existing Form S-3 filed July 28, 2025. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation; proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes. No special-situation mechanics, pricing, or strategic event apply; watch for periodic sales activity but no risk-arb angle.
